description: This file defines the ApplicationClientFactory interface for the Eclipse Hono client library. It specifies factory methods for creating and obtaining various client components to interact with Hono's northbound APIs, including telemetry, event, command, and response consumers, as well as command clients. The interface outlines methods for establishing these clients with supported parameters and returning futures that complete upon successful connection setup.

classes.name: ApplicationClientFactory
classes.description: A factory interface for creating and managing clients to interact with Hono's northbound APIs, including telemetry, events, commands, and responses.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static method to create a new factory instance for an existing connection.

methods.name: createTelemetryConsumer
methods.description: Creates a client for consuming telemetry data, establishing a link and returning a future that completes with the consumer.

methods.name: createEventConsumer
methods.description: Creates a client for consuming event messages from the Event API.

methods.name: createAsyncCommandResponseConsumer
methods.description: Creates a client for consuming responses to commands sent asynchronously, with a specified reply ID.

methods.name: getOrCreateCommandClient
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a command client for sending commands to devices of the specified tenant, using a generated reply-to address.

methods.name: getOrCreateCommandClient
methods.description: Overloaded method to retrieve or create a command client with a specified reply ID.

methods.name: getOrCreateAsyncCommandClient
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an asynchronous command client for the specified tenant.
